name: Ask questions
definition: Open-ended and self-directed questions that probe thinking.

name: Be explicit
definition: Naming the learning intention and the thinking strategy out loud.

name: Plan ahead
definition: A checklist, organiser or planned sequence used before starting.

name: Model your thinking
definition: Thinking aloud, including the moment of getting stuck.

name: Challenge students
definition: A harder or novel task that tests whether thinking transfers.

name: Evaluate progress
definition: Reflecting on the thinking process, not just the answer.

name: Promote collaboration
definition: Comparing how different people reasoned through the same problem.

name: Keep practising
definition: Repeating a thinking routine across content until it's durable.

name: Regularly check in
definition: Checking whether a habit is becoming independent, not just prompted.
